上午持1-A门票登顶马丘比丘山，预留下撤、巴士排队和取行李时间，搭乘下午或傍晚列: In the morning, climb Machu Picchu Mountain using a Circuit 1-A ticket, leaving time for descent, bus lines, and luggage retrieval, and catch the afternoon or evening train back to the Sacred Valley.
上午搭乘授权观光航班依次观察蜂鸟、猴子、宇航员、蜘蛛及神鹰等地画，下午前往坎塔洛: In the morning, take an authorized sightseeing flight to sequentially view the Hummingbird, Monkey, Astronaut, Spider, and Condor geoglyphs, then head to the Cantalloc Aqueducts in the afternoon to photograph the spiral stone wells. 上午早段或下午16:00前后的柔和光线。: Early morning or soft lighting conditions before 16:00 in the afternoon.

上午至下午的日间列车，5–9月群山轮廓清晰，12–3月峡谷植被更加浓密。: Daytime trains from morning to afternoon; mountain outlines are clear from May to September, while canyon vegetation is lush from December to March.
上午至正午前，云量较低时。: From morning until before noon, when cloud cover is low.
上午访问廷托雷拉斯小岛及获准浮潜区，随后依据已预订的西部邮轮登船港口安排接驳，必: Morning visit to Tintorera Islet and the authorized snorkeling area, followed by transfers arranged according to the booked western cruise departure port, with an extra transit day added if necessary.
上午较凉爽时段，侧光照亮风蚀凝灰岩沟壑与海鸟栖息区。: During the cooler morning hours, side lighting illuminates the wind-eroded tuff ravines and seabird nesting areas.
上午阴晴交替且河流水位安全时。: During mornings with alternating overcast and clear skies when river water levels are safe.
上午风浪较弱时，选择太阳能够照亮岩壁与水下浅层的访问窗口。: During mornings with lighter winds and waves, choose a visiting window when the sun illuminates the rock walls and shallow underwater areas.
下午16:00至日落后蓝调时段，斜射光突出密集屋顶的起伏与教堂双塔。: From 16:00 in the afternoon to the blue hour after sunset, oblique lighting highlights the undulating dense rooftops and church twin towers.

与平坦地面的多数地画不同，人形巨像绘于深色斜坡，圆形头部、大眼和抬起的手臂从粗糙: Unlike most geoglyphs on flat ground, the humanoid giant is drawn on a dark slope, its circular head, large eyes, and raised arms emerging from the rough rock layers, with background ridges and gullies reinforcing its three-dimensional presence.
与桑多瓦尔湖相比适合结合坦博帕塔河住宿深度游览。不要游泳或擅自上岸，使用长焦保持: Compared to Lake Sandoval, this is suitable for combining with a Tambopata River lodge stay for an in-depth exploration. 乘小艇探索运营方获准进入的河道，寻找粉红河豚及热带水鸟。: Explore operator-authorized river channels by skiff in search of pink river dolphins and tropical waterbirds.
乘持牌潜水船或浮潜船前往Kicker Rock，依据个人证照及海况选择水下活动，: Take a licensed dive or snorkel boat to Kicker Rock, choose underwater activities based on individual certification and sea conditions, and arrange a panoramic hike of Frigatebird Hill upon return.
乘获准快艇前往Los Túneles，在向导安排下观察蓝脚鲣鸟及海洋动物，拍摄熔: Take an authorized speedboat to Los Túneles, observe blue-footed boobies and marine animals under the guidance of your guide, and photograph the lava arch and crystal-clear water.
乘西部生态邮轮抵达伊莎贝拉岛西侧伊丽莎白湾，换乘橡皮艇沿红树林水道与Mariel: Take a western eco-cruise to Elizabeth Bay on the west side of Isabela Island, transfer to a dinghy for about 1 hour of marine observation along the mangrove channels and the periphery of the Marielas Islets.
乘西部邮轮抵伊莎贝拉岛西北端，换乘橡皮艇沿火山崖壁巡航，海况允许时由向导组织约3: Take the western cruise to the northwest end of Isabela Island, transfer to a dinghy to cruise along the volcanic cliffs, and enjoy 30–60 minutes of snorkeling organized by the guide when sea conditions permit.
乘车前往Caraz及帕龙湖，在西端湖岸及获准开放的高位观景区拍摄。: Drive to Caraz and Lake Parón, and photograph from the western lakeshore and authorized high-altitude viewing areas.
乘车北上经过高原保护区，在帕塔潘帕短暂停留，随后下降至 Chivay 入住，天气: Drive north through the plateau reserve, make a short stop at Patapampa, then descend to Chivay for check-in, and visit Antahuilque to photograph the terraced fields if weather permits.
乘车至Barranco区Jirón Medrano Silva 165附近，从公: Drive to the vicinity of Jirón Medrano Silva 165 in the Barranco district, and look for architectural facades and cross-sectional perspectives from the public sidewalk.
乘远征车辆经Chiquián抵达环线起点，适应高海拔营地。: Take an expedition vehicle via Chiquián to reach the circuit starting point and acclimate to the high-altitude camp.
乘长途车辆或经安塔机场抵达瓦拉斯，在约3050米海拔休息。: Take a long-distance vehicle or arrive in Huaraz via Anta Airport, and rest at an altitude of approximately 3,050 meters.
乘首班缆车进入Cruz Loma，轻量徒步拍摄城市与雪峰，午后下山。: Take the first cable car into Cruz Loma, take a light hike to photograph the city and snow peaks, and descend in the afternoon.

云雾雨林与峡谷白色水幕: Cloud forest and canyon white water veils

仅在火山管理部门允许进入时前往；道路湿滑或积雪时使用适宜车辆，出现明显高反立即下: Proceed only when volcanic management authorities permit entry; use suitable vehicles when roads are slippery or snowy, and descend immediately if severe altitude sickness symptoms appear.
从 Chivay 住宿点约 06:00 出发，建议 07:30 前抵达；5月上旬: Depart from your Chivay accommodation at around 06:00, with arrival recommended before 07:30; early May to late September is suitable for condor-watching trips, but condor sightings depend on wind conditions and individual activity. Use a 100–400mm telephoto lens; do not feed, chase, or use drones to disturb the birds.
从 Chivay 沿峡谷南岸公路向西行驶约 42 公里，车程约 75–90 分钟: Drive west from Chivay along the southern bank road of the canyon for about 42 kilometers (approx. 75–90 minutes by car); the walk from the parking lot to the main platform takes about 5 minutes.
从 Chivay 沿科尔卡峡谷南岸公路经 Yanque、Maca 向 Pinch: Drive from Chivay along the Colca Canyon south bank road through Yanque and Maca toward Pinchollo for about 50–65 minutes, park at the roadside viewpoint, and walk a few minutes.
从 Poroy 或 Ollantaytambo 搭乘 Hiram Bingham: Board the Hiram Bingham, Vistadome, or another authorized train from Poroy or Ollantaytambo, with a journey time of approximately 1.5–3.5 hours depending on the departure point; during the rainy season, some departures are replaced by combined road and rail services.
从4630米停车场沿开放登山步道爬升约45–90分钟。: Climb for about 45–90 minutes along the open mountaineering trail from the 4,630-meter parking lot.
从Barranco市政广场沿Pasaje Chabuca Granda步行约5分: Walk about 5 minutes from Barranco Municipal Square along Pasaje Chabuca Granda to reach the bridge deck, then follow the Bajada de los Baños slope to find compositions beneath the bridge.
从Cebollapampa进入69号湖正式徒步线路，中段约1–2小时可到达所在谷: Enter the official Lake 69 hiking trail from Cebollapampa, reaching the valley in about 1–2 hours during the middle section.
从Cocachimba村中心沿村道步行至朝向瀑布的开阔位置，或入住Gocta A: Walk from the center of Cocachimba village along the village path to an open spot facing the waterfall, or stay at Gocta Andes Lodge and use the lodge terrace (approx. 5–15 minutes' walk).
从Cocachimba村徒步前往下段瀑布，傍晚入住瀑布景观酒店。: Hike from Cocachimba village to the lower section of the waterfall, and check into a waterfall-view hotel in the evening.
从E35泛美公路经Control Caspi南入口入园，沿园内道路驾车约30–4: Enter the park from the E35 Pan-American Highway via the Control Caspi south entrance, and drive along park roads for about 30–45 minutes to the lakeside parking area.
从Huayllapa沿环线继续进入西侧山区，经Tapush山口前往Cashpap: Continue along the circuit from Huayllapa into the western mountains, passing through the Tapush Pass toward the campsite near Cashpapampa.
从Janca或Mitucocha营地翻越Carhuac山口，徒步约5–7小时抵达: Cross the Carhuac Pass from Janca or Mitucocha camp, and hike for about 5–7 hours to reach the campsite at the eastern end of the lake.
从Juliaca机场乘车前往普诺，充分休息。若身体适应良好，可乘出租车前往Kun: Drive from Juliaca Airport to Puno and rest thoroughly. If well-acclimatized, take a taxi to the Kuntur Wasi viewpoint for a brief stop.
从Kennedy公园沿Av. José Pardo或Malecón Balta方: Walk about 20–25 minutes from Kennedy Park along Av. José Pardo or Malecón Balta, or take a vehicle to the coastal promenade.
从Latacunga沿E30经Zumbahua转入Quilotoa道路，抵村庄后: Drive from Latacunga along the E30 via Zumbahua to turn onto the Quilotoa road, and walk about 5–10 minutes upon reaching the village.
从Latacunga经Zumbahua抵达Quilotoa，适应海拔后在主观景台: Drive from Latacunga via Zumbahua to Quilotoa, acclimate to the altitude, and observe the changing lake colors from the main viewpoint.
从Machachi经El Pedregal方向驶入获准开放的北部道路，或由园内道: Drive from Machachi via El Pedregal into the authorized northern road, or turn in from the park roads.
从Miraflores乘正规出租车约30–60分钟，或乘Metropolitan: Take a regular taxi from Miraflores for about 30–60 minutes, or take the Metropolitano rapid transit bus to the vicinity of Jirón de la Unión and walk.
从Pitec出发完成丘鲁普日线徒步，遇湿滑、雷暴或身体不适则取消。: Complete the Churup day-hike starting from Pitec, canceling if conditions become slippery, stormy, or you feel unwell.
从Quilotoa主村沿西侧环火山口步道徒步约2–3小时，或从Chugchilá: Hike about 2–3 hours from the main village of Quilotoa along the western crater-rim trail, or enter via the traditional hiking route from Chugchilán.
从Quilotoa村沿火山口南缘标识步道约45–90分钟，亦可驾车至Shalal: Follow the marked trail along the southern rim of the crater from Quilotoa village for about 45–90 minutes, or drive to the Shalalá community followed by a short walk.
从San Francisco地铁站步行约5分钟。: Walk about 5 minutes from San Francisco metro station.
从Shalalá方向沿东缘环线徒步，通常预留约1–2小时，具体取决于入口与步道条: Hike along the eastern rim circuit from the direction of Shalalá, typically allowing about 1–2 hours depending on entrance and trail conditions.
从Tambopaxi方向联系当地向导，沿北部开放支路和指定步道前往，预留2–3小: Contact a local guide from the direction of Tambopaxi, proceed along the northern open branch road and designated trails, allowing 2–3 hours.
从三湖观景台继续沿正式山口线路爬升约45–90分钟，再下撤至Huayhuash营: Continue climbing along the official pass route from the Three Lakes viewpoint for about 45–90 minutes, then descend to Huayhuash camp.
从主观景台沿南缘步道向Shalalá方向前进，约30–60分钟抵达附近。: Proceed from the main viewpoint along the southern rim trail toward Shalalá, arriving nearby in about 30–60 minutes.
从主观景台沿官方下湖步道下降约30–60分钟，返回上坡约1–2小时。: Descend from the main viewpoint along the official lakeside trail for about 30–60 minutes, with the return uphill taking about 1–2 hours.
从乌鲁班巴沿乌鲁班巴河谷公路向西驾车约30–40分钟抵达 Ollantaytam: Drive west from Urubamba along the Urubamba River Valley highway for about 30–40 minutes to reach Ollantaytambo; enter with the Sacred Valley tourist ticket and climb the giant agricultural terrace stone steps for about 20–30 minutes.
从乌鲁班巴沿通往 Maras 的地方公路及盐田支路驾车约30–45分钟，购票后沿: Drive from Urubamba along the local road toward Maras and the salt pans branch road for about 30–45 minutes, purchase a ticket, and walk 5–10 minutes along the designated visitor path to reach the viewing area.
从伊卡市中心乘出租车约 10–20 分钟抵达绿洲，沿公共湖岸步道环湖约 20–3: Take a taxi from downtown Ica for about 10–20 minutes to reach the oasis, and walk around the lake along the public lakeshore path for about 20–30 minutes.
从伊基托斯乘船前往ExplorNapo Lodge，下午沿授权步道进行雨林自然观: Take a boat from Iquitos to ExplorNapo Lodge, and enjoy an afternoon rainforest nature observation along authorized trails.
从伊基托斯或Bellavista-Nanay码头搭乘当地快艇至Barrio Fl: Take a local speedboat from Iquitos or the Bellavista-Nanay dock to the Barrio Florido community, then walk about 5 minutes into the park.
从伊基托斯沿PE-5S伊基托斯至纳乌塔公路乘车约1.5–2小时，再从纳乌塔乘快艇: Drive from Iquitos along the PE-5S Iquitos-Nauta highway for about 1.5–2 hours, then take a speedboat from Nauta for about 45 minutes to reach the Miguel Grau community viewing area.
从伊基托斯经亚马孙河及纳波河乘船前往ExplorNapo Lodge或ACTS研: Travel by boat from Iquitos via the Amazon and Napo rivers to ExplorNapo Lodge or the ACTS Research Station, then follow guides along forest trails into the canopy walkway system; at least 2–3 days is recommended.
从保护区入口沿开放海岸公路向 Yumaque 和 La Catedral 方向行: Drive from the reserve entrance along the open coastal road toward Yumaque and La Catedral for about 25–40 minutes, park, and walk the designated short trail.
从保护区游客服务区域沿半岛公路前往 Playa Roja 方向，驾车约 10–2: From the reserve visitor service area, follow the peninsula road toward Playa Roja. Drive for about 10–20 minutes to reach the isthmus viewpoint area.
从利马武器广场向南沿Jirón Ucayali附近街道步行约5分钟。: From the Plaza de Armas in Lima, walk south along the streets near Jirón Ucayali for about 5 minutes.
从十二角石继续沿 Cuesta de San Blas 上坡，步行约10–15分: From the Stone of Twelve Angles, continue uphill along Cuesta de San Blas, walking for about 10–15 minutes to Plaza San Blas and the adjacent viewing steps.
从卡尔瓦科查营地沿湖岸和当地向导确认的支线徒步约30–90分钟。: From the Carhuacocha campsite, hike along the lakeshore and the branch trail confirmed by local guides for about 30–90 minutes.
从卡尔瓦科查营地沿通往Siula Pass的高山步道徒步约3–4小时。: From the Carhuacocha campsite, hike along the alpine trail leading to Siula Pass for about 3–4 hours.
从古城乘车约20–35分钟抵缆车下站，再乘缆车约18分钟上山。: From the ancient city, take a vehicle for about 20–35 minutes to the lower cable car station, then take the cable car for about 18 minutes to the top.
从古城搭乘正规出租车或包车约15–20分钟直达山顶。: From the ancient city, take a licensed taxi or private car for about 15–20 minutes directly to the summit.
从圣克里斯托瓦尔岛乘获准埃斯帕尼奥拉日游船航行约1小时45分钟至2.5小时，登陆: From San Cristóbal Island, take an authorized Española day cruise for about 1 hour 45 minutes to 2.5 hours. After a dry landing, follow a rocky trail of about 2 km for a 2–2.5 hour tour.
从圣克鲁斯乘岛际快艇或符合行李条件的小型飞机抵达比利亚米尔港，下午在珍珠贝潟湖进: From Santa Cruz, take an inter-island speedboat or a small aircraft meeting luggage conditions to Puerto Villamil. Spend the afternoon with light ecological observation at the Pearl Shell Lagoon.
从奇南科查湖游客区沿Yungay–Yanama公路继续向东北行驶，在许可安全停车: From the Chinacocha Lake visitor area, continue driving northeast along the Yungay–Yanama road, and walk to shoot at permitted safe parking areas.
从奥扬泰坦博历史镇中心沿 Calle Lares 步行至带标识的登山口，沿陡峭碎: From the historic center of Ollantaytambo, walk along Calle Lares to the marked trailhead, and climb up the steep gravel and stone step trail for about 30–45 minutes.
从已完成海拔适应的基多出发，环湖观察雪峰、水鸟与帕拉莫植被，随后入住公园外围山庄: Departing from Quito after completing altitude acclimatization, observe the snow-capped peaks, waterbirds, and paramo vegetation around the lake, then check into a lodge on the periphery of the park.
从巴克里索莫雷诺港乘持牌潜水船或浮潜船航行约45–75分钟抵达，在许可区域绕岩巡: From Puerto Baquerizo Moreno, take a licensed dive boat or snorkeling boat for a 45–75 minute sail to arrive. Cruise around the rocks in permitted areas or enter the water under the organization of a professional dive guide.
从巴克里索莫雷诺港乘获准游艇沿圣克里斯托瓦尔岛北岸航行约1.5–2.5小时，湿登: From Puerto Baquerizo Moreno, take an authorized natural yacht to sail along the north coast of San Cristóbal Island for about 1.5–2.5 hours. After a wet landing, follow a guide to climb up the volcanic valley trail for about 1–2 hours.
从巴克里索莫雷诺港乘获准自然游艇约1小时抵达西北岸，按船只许可进行湿登陆或沿凝灰: From Puerto Baquerizo Moreno, take an authorized natural yacht for about 1 hour to reach the northwest coast. Conduct a wet landing or cruise along the tuff coastline according to vessel permits.
从巴克里索莫雷诺港市区乘出租车约10分钟至海滩入口，沿规定海岸步道步行约10–2: From downtown Puerto Baquerizo Moreno, take a taxi for about 10 minutes to the beach entrance, and walk along the designated coastal trail for about 10–20 minutes.
从巴克里索莫雷诺港步行至国家公园解释中心，再沿开放步道爬升约20–30分钟抵海湾: Walk from Puerto Baquerizo Moreno to the National Park Interpretation Center, then climb up the open trail for about 20–30 minutes to reach the bay viewing area.
从巴尼奥斯城区搭乘往返树屋的公共巴士、旅游接驳车或包车，盘山约30–45分钟。: Take a public bus, tourist shuttle, or chartered car from Baños town center to the Treehouse, winding through the mountains for about 30–45 minutes.
从巴尼奥斯沿E30向东行驶约17公里至Río Verde，选择开放入口，沿瀑布步: Drive east from Baños along the E30 for about 17 kilometers to Río Verde, choose an open entrance, and hike along the waterfall trail for about 20–40 minutes.
从巴尼奥斯沿E30向东驾车约10–20分钟，使用指定停车及观景区域。: Drive east from Baños along the E30 for about 10–20 minutes, and use the designated parking and viewing areas.
从巴尼奥斯沿E30瀑布公路向东，抵Manto de la Novia指定观景区，: Drive east from Baños along the E30 waterfall highway to the Manto de la Novia designated viewing area, with a driving time of about 20–30 minutes.
从巴尼奥斯经Ambato及E35方向前往昆卡，约285公里，预留5–7小时及道路: Travel from Baños via Ambato and the E30 direction toward Cuenca, about 285 kilometers, reserving 5–7 hours and time for road delays.
从帕尔科约主观景区沿社区开放步道继续前行约15–30分钟。: Continue walking along the community-accessible trail from the Palccoyo main viewpoint for about 15–30 minutes.
从帕尔科约彩虹山步道沿石林支线徒步爬升约20–40分钟。: Hike and climb along the stone forest branch trail from the Palccoyo Rainbow Mountain trail for about 20–40 minutes.
从帕拉卡斯 El Chaco 码头乘 SERNANP 授权运营商游船，常规往返约: Take a boat from Paracas El Chaco pier operated by a SERNANP-authorized operator. The regular round trip takes about 1 hour 40 minutes to 2 hours, passing by the Paracas Candelabra geoglyph along the way.
从库斯科乘车前往塔赖观景台拍摄乌鲁班巴河谷，随后深入皮萨克考古公园拍摄巨型山腰梯: Take a vehicle from Cusco to the Taray viewpoint to photograph the Urubamba Valley, then head deep into the Pisac Archaeological Park to photograph the giant hillside terraces, and check in at Urubamba along the valley by evening.
从库斯科或奥扬泰坦博乘日间观景列车进入热带山地森林，下午抵达热水镇办理入住，确认: Take a daytime scenic train from Cusco or Ollantaytambo into the tropical montane forest, arrive in Aguas Calientes in the afternoon to check in, and confirm next day's tickets and transfer arrangements.
从库斯科武器广场包车或出租车约10–15分钟至萨克塞华曼考古公园，入场后沿指定草: Take a chartered car or taxi from the Cusco Plaza de Armas for about 10–15 minutes to the Saksaywaman Archaeological Park. After entering, walk along the designated turf trail for 5–15 minutes to reach the giant stone wall.
从库斯科沿PE-3S公路南行至Cusipata，转山区道路前往Chillihua: Drive south from Cusco along the PE-3S highway to Cusipata, turn onto the mountain road toward the Chillihuani direction to the mountain parking lot, about a 3-hour drive, followed by a 1.5–2 hour hike.
从库斯科沿PE-3S至Checacupe，再沿社区山区道路驶往Palccoyo停: Drive from Cusco along the PE-3S to Checacupe, then drive along the community mountain road to the Palccoyo parking lot, about a 3.5–4 hour drive, followed by a 30–60 minute walk.
从库斯科沿通往 Chinchero 与 Urubamba 的公路驾车约45–60: Drive from Cusco along the road leading to Chinchero and Urubamba for about 45–60 minutes, and enter the historic square and surrounding Inca terrace ruins with an archaeological pass.
从库斯科经通往皮萨克的山地公路，在 Taray 河谷观景台停车，步行约1–3分钟: Drive from Cusco via the mountain road to Pisac, park at the Taray Valley viewpoint, and walk for about 1–3 minutes to reach the public framing area.
从彩虹山主观景台沿获准开放的红谷支线徒步约30–60分钟，通常需要另付社区门票。: Hike along the authorized open Red Valley branch trail from the Rainbow Mountain main viewpoint for about 30–60 minutes, usually requiring an additional community ticket.
从新大教堂沿Padre Aguirre及Presidente Córdova附近: Walk from the New Cathedral along the streets near Padre Aguirre and Presidente Córdova for about 5 minutes.
从昆卡古城乘正规出租车沿Avenida Mirador de Turi上山，约1: Take a regular taxi from Cuenca's ancient city up the mountain along Avenida Mirador de Turi, taking about 15–25 minutes.
从昆卡新大教堂沿老城区向东南步行约20–30分钟，或乘车约10分钟。: Walk southeast from the Cuenca New Cathedral along the old town for about 20–30 minutes, or take a vehicle for about 10 minutes.
从普诺Puerto Lacustre码头搭乘社区授权游船，约25–40分钟进入浮: Take a community-authorized boat from the Puno Puerto Lacustre pier, entering the floating island cluster in about 25–40 minutes.
从普诺乘船约1.5–3小时抵达塔基勒岛，再从登陆码头沿石砌步道爬升约30–60分: Take a boat from Puno for about 1.5–3 hours to reach Taquile Island, then climb up the stone-paved trail from the landing pier for about 30–60 minutes.
从普诺乘船约3–4小时抵达阿曼塔尼岛，再从社区民宿沿梯田石道步行约45–90分钟: Take a boat from Puno for about 3–4 hours to reach Amantaní Island, then walk from the community guesthouse along the terraced stone path for about 45–90 minutes.
从普诺市中心乘出租车约10–15分钟上山，预约司机返回接送。: Take a taxi from downtown Puno up the mountain for about 10–15 minutes, and schedule the driver for a return pickup.
从普诺沿通往Atuncolla的公路乘车约45–60分钟，抵达考古遗址游客入口后: Drive from Puno along the road toward Atuncolla for about 45–60 minutes, arrive at the archaeological site visitor entrance, and hike for about 15–25 minutes.
从普诺经Juliaca及Capachica方向道路抵达Llachón社区，约2–: Drive from Puno via the roads toward Juliaca and Capachica to reach the Llachón community, about a 2–3 hour drive, then walk for about 20–40 minutes.
从林皮奥蓬戈湖乘车沿火山北坡砂石盘山路上行约40–60分钟。: Drive from Limpiopungo Lake along the volcano's northern slope gravel winding road upward for about 40–60 minutes.
从查查波亚斯沿乌特库班巴河谷公路前往Nuevo Tingo，车程约1–1.5小时: Drive from Chachapoyas along the Utcubamba River Valley road to Nuevo Tingo, taking about 1–1.5 hours; transfer to the operator's shuttle bus and a roughly 20-minute cable car to reach the Malcapampa visitor center, then walk into the archaeological zone.
从查查波亚斯经Lamud乘车约1–1.5小时，再由游客中心步行约15分钟进入洞穴: Drive from Chachapoyas via Lamud for about 1–1.5 hours, then walk from the visitor center for about 15 minutes to enter the cave open tour route.
从查查波亚斯经Luya前往Cruz Pata社区，车程约1.5–2小时，随后沿坡: Drive from Chachapoyas via Luya to the Cruz Pata community, taking about 1.5–2 hours, then walk along the sloping trail for about 20–30 minutes to reach the cliff viewing area.
从武器广场沿 Avenida El Sol 向南步行约10分钟抵达神殿，购买相应: Walk south from the Plaza de Armas along Avenida El Sol for about 10 minutes to reach the temple, purchase corresponding separate tickets to enter the monastery and Inca architectural remains.
从武器广场沿 Calle Resbalosa 等坡道向北步行约15–25分钟，或: Walk north from the Plaza de Armas along ramps such as Calle Resbalosa for about 15–25 minutes, or take a taxi to reach San Cristóbal Church Square.
从武器广场沿 Calle Triunfo 向东进入 Hatun Rumiyoq: Walk east from the Plaza de Armas along Calle Triunfo into the Hatun Rumiyoq historic street, taking about 5–8 minutes.
从武器广场沿Jirón Ancash向东步行约5–8分钟抵达修道院入口。: Walk east from the Plaza de Armas along Jirón Ancash for about 5–8 minutes to reach the monastery entrance.
从武器广场跨越奇利河向西北步行约 25–35 分钟，或乘出租车约 10–15 分: Cross the Chili River northwest from the Plaza de Armas on foot for about 25–35 minutes, or take a taxi for about 10–15 minutes.
从比利亚米尔港主码头附近进入红树林木栈道，步行约5–10分钟到达下水平台，按当天: Enter the mangrove boardwalk near the Puerto Villamil main pier, walk for about 5–10 minutes to reach the water-entry platform, and enter according to the day's public access regulations.
从比利亚米尔港乘持牌快艇向西南航行约45–70分钟，在向导带领下进行获准熔岩岸线: Take a licensed speedboat from Puerto Villamil southwest for about 45–70 minutes, and under the guidance of a guide, conduct permitted lava shoreline walks and snorkeling in nearby waters.
从比利亚米尔港乘车约30–45分钟前往火山步道管制入口，随持证向导徒步约3公里抵: Take a vehicle from Puerto Villamil for about 30–45 minutes to the volcanic trail control entrance, hike with a certified guide for about 3 kilometers to the eastern rim viewing area; continuing to the full Volcán Chico route usually totals about 16 kilometers round trip.
从比利亚米尔港码头乘持牌小艇约10–15分钟，登陆后沿规定熔岩步道步行约30–6: Take a licensed dinghy from the Puerto Villamil pier for about 10–15 minutes. After landing, walk along the designated lava trail for about 30–60 minutes, then head to the permitted snorkeling waters.
从海军灯塔沿Malecón Cisneros步行至爱情公园，继续前往萨拉萨尔公园: Walk from the Naval Lighthouse along Malecón Cisneros to Love Park, continue to Salazar Park, and wait for the Pacific sunset.
从游客中心沿园区道路进入La Rinconada区域，获准后在营地外围短距离步行: Walk from the visitor center along the park road into the La Rinconada area, and after permission, take a short walk on the periphery of the campsite.
从湖西端游客区沿允许通行的碎石观景步道爬升约30–45分钟。: Climb up the permitted gravel viewing trail from the visitor area at the western end of the lake for about 30–45 minutes.
从湖边停车区步行进入标识步道，环湖约1–1.5小时。: Walk from the lakeside parking area into the marked trail, circling the lake in about 1–1.5 hours.
从热水镇 Aguas Calientes 乘 Hiram Bingham 公路接: Take the Hiram Bingham highway shuttle bus from Aguas Calientes for about 25–30 minutes to reach the site entrance, then walk along the Circuit 1-B designated stone steps for 15–25 minutes to the upper terrace.
从爱情公园沿Malecón Cisneros向西北步行约10分钟，免费进入灯塔周: Walk northwest from Love Park along Malecón Cisneros for about 10 minutes to freely enter the coastal public lawn around the lighthouse.
从独立广场沿Venezuela街步行约15分钟，购票进入开放塔楼。: Walk from Independence Square along Venezuela Street for about 15 minutes, and purchase a ticket to enter the open tower.
从瓦卡奇纳湖西南侧进入允许步行的沙坡，沿沙脊缓慢攀登约 20–40 分钟，避开越: Enter the walkable sand slope from the southwest side of Huacachina Oasis, climb slowly along the sand ridge for about 20–40 minutes, avoiding the off-road vehicle traffic area.
从瓦拉斯乘车经Chiquián前往Quartelhuain，随后翻越Cacana: Drive from Huaraz via Chiquián to Quartelhuain, then cross the Cacananpunta Pass to enter the Janca campsite, and hike to the lakeshore.
从瓦拉斯前往Pitec登山口约45–60分钟，沿丘鲁普步道徒步约2–3小时。: Drive from Huaraz to the Pitec trailhead in about 45–60 minutes, and hike along the Churup trail for about 2–3 hours.
从瓦拉斯沿PE-3N北行至Caraz，再沿帕龙峡谷山区道路约32公里抵达湖西端，: Drive north from Huaraz along the PE-3N to Caraz, then drive along the Paron Canyon mountain road for about 32 kilometers to the western end of the lake, with a total driving time of about 3–4 hours.
从瓦拉斯沿PE-3N至Yungay，转Yungay–Yanama山区公路至Ceb: Drive from Huaraz along the PE-3N to Yungay, turn onto the Yungay–Yanama mountain road to Cebollapampa, about a 2.5–3 hour drive, then hike for about 3 hours one way.
从皮萨克镇沿通往考古公园的山路乘车约20–30分钟至上部入口，再沿官方石阶及山脊: Take a vehicle from Pisac town along the mountain road leading to the archaeological park for about 20–30 minutes to the upper entrance, then walk along the official stone steps and ridge trail for about 30–90 minutes to tour the open areas.
从石林区域出发，由当地向导沿允许通行的高位路线徒步约30–60分钟。: Starting from the stone forest area, a local guide will lead a hike along the permitted upper route for about 30–60 minutes.
从纳乌塔搭乘SERNANP授权运营方船只进入保护区Yanayacu-Pucate: Take a boat operated by a SERNANP-authorized operator from Nauta to enter the Yanayacu-Pucate basin of the reserve. Specific tributary voyages vary with water levels, usually arranging multi-day jungle boat stays or expedition cruises.
从纳斯卡 María Reiche Neuman 机场乘合法观光飞机，参加通常约: Take a legal sightseeing aircraft from Maria Reiche Neuman Airport in Nazca, participating in the standard geoglyph flight route which usually takes about 30–40 minutes.
从纳斯卡市中心向东乘车约 10–20 分钟，进入考古遗址后沿开放参观路径步行约: Drive east from downtown Nazca for about 10–20 minutes, enter the archaeological site, and walk along the open visiting path for about 30–60 minutes.
从纳斯卡市区沿泛美南部公路 PE-1S 向北行驶约 20–25 公里，约30分钟: Drive north from downtown Nazca along the Pan-American Southern Highway PE-1S for about 20–25 kilometers, arriving at the roadside geoglyph viewing facility in about 30 minutes.
从纳斯卡市区沿纳斯卡河谷向西乘车约 25–30 公里，其中部分为非铺装道路，车程: Drive west from downtown Nazca along the Nazca River Valley for about 25–30 kilometers, some of which are unpaved roads, taking about 45–60 minutes.
从纳斯卡机场乘授权小型观光飞机，经官方许可的地画观赏线路飞过对应山坡区域。: Take an authorized small sightseeing plane from Nazca Airport, flying over the corresponding hillside area via the officially permitted geoglyph viewing route.
从绿洲乘持证运营商的 dune buggy 沙漠越野车深入西部沙丘，通常参加约: Take a dune buggy desert off-road vehicle from a licensed operator from the oasis deep into the western dunes, usually participating in a sandboarding and sunset activity of about 1–2 hours.
从萨克塞华曼外围道路步行约15–25分钟，或从武器广场乘出租车约15分钟抵达公共: Walk from the periphery road of Saksaywaman for about 15–25 minutes, or take a taxi from the Plaza de Armas for about 15 minutes to reach the public viewing area.
从萨克塞华曼沿通往 Písac 方向的城郊道路乘车约5–10分钟，持 COSIT: Drive from Saksaywaman along the suburban road toward Písac for about 5–10 minutes, enter the park with the corresponding COSITUC pass, and tour along the official trail.
从赤道纪念碑外围沿公共道路步行约10–15分钟进入博物馆。: Walk from the periphery of the Equator Monument along the public road for about 10–15 minutes to enter the museum.
从钦切罗沿通往乌鲁班巴的高原公路驾车约10–20分钟，在标记的 Racchi 观: Drive from Chinchero along the plateau road toward Urubamba for about 10–20 minutes, and park at the marked Racchi viewing area.
从阿曼塔尼社区沿当地步道徒步约45–90分钟，具体路线由民宿主人指引。: Hike from the Amantaní community along local trails for about 45–90 minutes, with the specific route guided by the guesthouse host.
从阿约拉港乘车约40分钟至伊塔巴卡海峡码头，换乘持牌游艇约1.5–2小时抵达巴托: Drive from Puerto Ayora for about 40 minutes to the Itabaca Channel pier, transfer to a licensed yacht for about 1.5–2 hours to reach Bartholomew Island, and after landing, climb up the 600-meter wooden boardwalk and steps for about 25–40 minutes.
从阿约拉港公共码头乘水上出租船约5分钟至另一侧码头，经过Playa de los: Take a water taxi from the Puerto Ayora public pier for about 5 minutes to the other side pier, pass by Playa de los Alemanes and the salt ponds, and walk along the rocky trail for about 20–30 minutes.
从阿约拉港沿通往Santa Rosa的中央公路驱车约30–45分钟，进入获准开放: Drive from Puerto Ayora along the central road toward Santa Rosa for about 30–45 minutes, enter the permitted open highland giant tortoise observation area, and walk with a guide for about 1–2 hours.
从阿约拉港西侧Tortuga Bay步道管理入口登记，沿铺装步道步行约2.5公里: Register at the Tortuga Bay trail management entrance on the west side of Puerto Ayora, walk along the paved trail for about 2.5 kilometers (35–50 minutes) to reach Playa Brava, and then walk along the coast for about 15 minutes to Playa Mansa.
从阿雷基帕武器广场沿 Calle Santa Catalina 向北步行约 5–: Walk north from the Arequipa Plaza de Armas along Calle Santa Catalina for about 5–8 minutes. After entering the monastery, reserve 2–3 hours to explore the cloisters, courtyards, and historic alleys.
从阿雷基帕老城乘车经 Cayma 区前往 Carmen Alto，约 15–25: Drive from the Arequipa old town via the Cayma district to Carmen Alto, about 15–25 minutes. After parking, take a short walk along the viewing area.
从马尔多纳多港乘船约45分钟抵达Inkaterra Reserva Amazón: Take a boat from Puerto Maldonado for about 45 minutes to reach the Inkaterra Reserva Amazónica lodge area, then walk with a lodge guide for about 15 minutes to the canopy facility entrance.
从马尔多纳多港沿Madre de Dios河乘船约30–45分钟抵达保护区入口，: Take a boat from Puerto Maldonado along the Madre de Dios River for about 30–45 minutes to reach the reserve entrance, hike through about 3 kilometers of rainforest trail, and then transfer to a canoe to enter the lake area.
从马尔多纳多港经Infierno社区码头乘船进入坦博帕塔河中段，入住Posada: Take a boat from the Infierno community pier in Puerto Maldonado to enter the middle section of the Tambopata River, check into Posada Amazonas or join an authorized ecological tour, then hike along the rainforest trail for about 20–30 minutes to reach the lakeshore and transfer to a canoe.
从马尔多纳多港经Interoceánica Sur公路进入坦博帕塔河上游支线，乘: Enter the upper tributaries of the Tambopata River from Puerto Maldonado via the Interoceánica Sur highway, reach the upper rainforest lodge by vehicle and speedboat, and then take a boat in the early morning to the designated observation area at the clay lick.
